claude_proposed_widenings.name: delegated_open_list_spell_cast
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main property does not grant a named spell. It chooses an arbitrary eligible Wizard spell at use time, then on success delegates resolution to that spell's own authored procedure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation_cost.uses_delegated_spell_casting_time
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activation cost is not a fixed action/bonus action/reaction. It inherits the chosen spell's normal casting time, which the current magic-item activation surface cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation_resource.spell_slot_of_chosen_spell_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The property consumes the user's own spell slot rather than an item use-count or charge pool.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_check_gate.dc_plus_chosen_spell_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Arcana check DC is dynamic and depends on the chosen spell's level; current ability_check_gate only carries a fixed numeric DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: make an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level)
